rows.why: consecutive blocks of k share one count
residue classes mod n/k share one count
circular windows give every item its own count

residual_note: PAIR-LOCK (S5g) locks items into n/2 = 500 pairs, not n/k = 100 blocks, so its effective bin count is 5x larger than BLOCK-LOCK's and its predicted shrinkage is correspondingly smaller. Assuming n/k for all three would mis-predict S5g.
